claim: Before optimising hooks in a CPU-paced game, find where the frame is paced; a limiter at the pacing point plus 28 MHz for the work can make hook cost irrelevant.

evidence.text: The game frame runs inside the IM2 handler with interrupts off, one per LIMIT = 3 interrupts.
Frame limiter plus turbo build was very smooth on hardware; a speed build without a limiter is listed separately.
